author: kycrafft
body:
Look I know we haven't even pushed out our nebula tournament yet, but I want to suggest maybe having some more. I think it would be interesting to have CTH and Walls tournaments. It could also help boost player counts in those gamemodes too.



Some special rules could be along the lines of:

Walls: 2 teams (10 player max),1 half of each team in a quadrant and each player must pick a different kit

CTH: 2 teams (8 player max), kits are limited to the first 5 or 6 kits, 159-200 max player limit
